Metadata.title: Solara Studios
Metadata.description: Solara is your new destination for fun with friends! A Brazilian studio, full of personality and representativeness.

Backstabbers.title: Backstabbers
Backstabbers.description: n a society where everyone wants to be more powerful than others and where their desires are greater than their neighbors, no one will measure their efforts to achieve their goals. Don't trust anyone, not even yourself!

Decodica.title: Decodica
Decodica.description: DecoDica is a super versatile party or social game that can be played in 5 different ways, where players are challenged to work their creativity, speed and interpretation ability.

Ordem.title: Order to Chaos
Ordem.description: Trying to become the new leader of the Cat Gang, Catuaba has put into practice a strategy to increase its influence: destabilize the Dog Armada. But their plans fell apart when the Armada discovered that the poop in the courtyard was actually feline! Even with the culprit revealed, chaos ensued. Now, with both groups in internal and external conflict, Nala and Valerius see no alternative: it's time to join forces to restore peace. You must interfere in the confusion and put an end to this war - within groups and between species.

Rebeliao.title: Cats' Rebellion
Rebeliao.description: The cat gang organized a rebellion against Chief Nala's command, setting up a coup that took the big feline from power. Now the factions are fighting to get as many cats and take the power of the legendary gang. Will you master these beasts?
